new visual direction with project context
avoid_or_gate_when: the task is trivial or backend-only
the provider would introduce a competing product/design source of truth
another primary craft provider is already building the same pass
notes: Prefer for substantial Operate/product UI when available and compatible.
Project product/design truth outranks provider defaults.

avoid_or_gate_when: its stylistic defaults conflict with accepted project direction
notes: Use as the primary craft approach OR as a fresh critic; do not blend it with another builder doctrine in the same build pass.
Do not inherit style dials or stack preferences as universal project rules.

setup cost outweighs value for a small task
the project does not already use Storybook and adding it is not independently justified

avoid_or_gate_when: Figma is not part of the project workflow
the task can be grounded from canonical code/runtime sources

best_for: design variants when Stitch is already available
avoid_or_gate_when: the workflow would become dependent on an unavailable service
another visual exploration provider already covers the task

hallmark.reason: Useful macrostructure-first and design-DNA/reference-study ideas. Its stylistic heuristics are not universal project truth, so the principles are internalized in direction.md rather than making Hallmark mandatory.

gstack-design-shotgun.reason: Useful concrete-variant comparison and selection workflow. The full gstack skill stack is too broad/opinionated to become a default dependency; Design Pipeline adopts lightweight divergence-before-production instead.

gpt-taste.reason: Aggressive anti-default design influence. The reviewed taste-v2 provider is the routable experimental form; generic gpt-taste doctrine is not loaded as a second simultaneous builder.

codebuff-evalbuff.reason: Useful influence for baseline-vs-harness outcome evaluation and ablation. Harness evaluation belongs in evals/, not inside the design runtime protocol.

anthropic-generator-evaluator.reason: Useful evidence for separating generation from fresh evaluation on tasks near the model's capability boundary, while avoiding evaluator overhead on trivial work.

ui-craft.reason: Useful craft-system reference, but its opinionated doctrine/global scoring is not core.

emil-kowalski-skills.reason: Useful motion purpose/frequency/interruption/reduced-motion guidance; numeric recipes are not universal rules.

garden-skills.reason: Useful grounding and design-context ideas; mandatory checkpoints/recipes are too workflow-heavy.

tastemaker.reason: Useful real-pixel grounding and continuity concepts; competing memory system and large gate set are not adopted.
